outcome: Validity of self-administered tests for chronic pregnancy-related pelvic girdle pain (PGP)
Comparison of self-administered tests with clinically performed tests
cohort: Women who previously had pelvic girdle pain during pregnancy and participated in one of three previous randomized controlled trials were followed up years after delivery.
finding: A battery of self-administered tests combined with additional specific questions or a pain-drawing can be used as a screening tool to diagnose chronic PGP years after delivery, although the modified SLR test has limitations.
